text: Can you send someone tomorrow morning at ten-thirty? The fridge is not cooling.

I can note that down for you. We do cover fridge inspections, which are 250 rupees, but the charge is waived if you go ahead with the repair. Before I record this, could you tell me your name and which area you are in? We serve Madhapur, Gachibowli, Kondapur, and Kukatpally only.
